summary: Both parts of the proposal are in 60633eff3. The server now emits ESM only, and the current apps/server/dist contains only .mjs files plus client, device-helper and resource-monitor. DESKTOP_BUILD_FILES excludes cua-driver, ryco-computer-use-helper(.exe) and ryco-computer-ui-helper from prod-resources and keeps the icons. The only consumer of prod-resources is resolveResourcePath, which loads icons. Every excluded binary still ships through extraResources and is resolved from process.resourcesPath. A test pins the exclusion list. One small leftover: apps/server/dist/device-helper (about 140 KiB of Swift sources) sits in the asar and is also shipped through mac extraResources. That is negligible.

evidence.note: format: ["esm"]. The cjs output is gone, and the local dist has no .cjs files.
The prod-resources binaries are excluded and the icons stay. The security helper was already excluded.
extraResources still delivers use-helper (all platforms) and, on mac, ui-helper, cua-driver, security-helper and device-helper.
The prod-resources copy is kept for AppImage icons.
resolveResourcePath, the only prod-resources consumer, resolves icon.* only.
A test pins the new exclusions.
Minor: apps/server/dist/device-helper (140 KiB of sources) is duplicated in the asar and in extraResources. Negligible.

implementationSketch: Optional and negligible: add '!apps/server/dist/device-helper/**' to DESKTOP_BUILD_FILES. Only do this after checking that the server resolves the helper only through RYCO_DEVICE_HELPER_SOURCE_DIR (backendLauncher.ts:104) in desktop mode. Saves about 140 KiB.
